sentences.text:
This is repeat second application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (in short "B.N.S.S."), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.85/2024, dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station-Agar, District-Agar Malwa (M.P.)
for the commission of offence punishable under sections 420, 467 and 471 of the IPC.
First bail application of the applicant was dismissed on merits vide order dated 22.07.2024 in MCRC No.26059/2024.
After rejection of earlier bail application of the applicant on merits there is no change in circumstances in which this repeat application can be considered.
(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Gopal Sondhiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78617270/
